title: Evidence command redaction misses secret headers and JSON payload secrets
description: recordEvidence redacts flags, env assignments, query params, and Bearer tokens, but curl/header forms such as -H "X-API-Key: ...", Authorization: Basic, and JSON --data password/token payloads can still be stored in durable evidence records.
acceptanceCriteria: Evidence command redaction covers -H/--header Authorization, X-API-Key, cookie, token, secret, Basic credentials, and common JSON body secret fields.
Existing redaction behavior for flags, env vars, query params, and Bearer tokens remains covered.
Regression tests prove durable evidence never stores representative header or JSON payload secrets.
